args.text: First look: a popcorn shop. 1,525 coins at top. Top panel: three customers at a red counter, each wanting a popcorn cup. Middle panel (red outline): a packing station with cups on a belt and cream dispensers. Bottom: a big popcorn cart with a circular red/blue ring around it, like a dial or a timer, and a gauge needle. Right column: machine cards, some empty dashed slots. Bottom yellow button: cart icon, 175 coins, +11 -> +14 with red up arrow = upgrade. I think I can tap the cart (to pop popcorn?), maybe drag around the ring, tap the upgrade button to buy. Expect tapping the cart makes popcorn.

Tapped cart: coins 1525->1539. Popcorn puffs flew into middle station, a cup moved, a new customer appeared. The ring now has a needle at the top and a yellow arc on the left side. Maybe tapping when the needle is in the yellow zone is better? Will tap again.
+12 this time. Needle stays at top, yellow arc on the left. Not sure what the ring means yet. I have plenty of coins (1551) - let me buy the 175 upgrade (+11 -> +14 per pop I guess).

Bought upgrade: 1551->1398 (wait, that's -153 not -175? maybe I earned some meanwhile). Cart got wider, star appeared, kernels sprayed. Next 430 for +14->+18. Customers queue is filling. Now curious about the ring: the left part is yellow, right part blue, there's a little pressure gauge bottom-right. Let me try HOLDING the cart to see if it heats up.

Holding 2s: +22 coins, and 2 of the 9 little dots under the cart turned gold. A white tick appeared on the left side of the ring by the yellow arc. Maybe the hold length fills a meter, and releasing at the right moment (in yellow) is good? Popcorn jar in middle panel filled up. Let me try a longer hold, 4s.

4s hold = big black smoke, the popcorn in the jar is brown = BURNT. Dots stayed at 2. So the ring is a cooking clock: I think the needle goes clockwise from the top while holding: blue (raw) on the right/bottom, yellow (golden) on the left, red (burnt) top-left. A tap = undercooked, 2s = golden (dot gained), 4s = burnt. Aha moment! Try 2.3s to aim for middle of yellow.
2.3s: the marker stopped in the RED part (top-left), no new dot. Some brownish bits fall. So too long. Golden must be shorter, try 1.8s. Coins keep rising on their own a bit too (1450->1522).
1.8s: marker at left in yellow, dots jumped to 4 of 9! Golden. Satisfying. Meanwhile something in the middle station puffed smoke (a burnt cup?). Buying the 430 upgrade, then more 1.8s holds.

Upgraded (now +18 per serve, next 1050). The cart got bunting flags. Golden again, 6 dots filled. Marker landed lower-left of yellow this time - interesting, so the needle speed may have changed with the upgrade? Customers pay +12 floating text. Wonder what happens when all 9 dots fill.

1.9s = burnt, big smoke, dots stayed 6. Hmm, 1.8 was golden and 1.9 burnt? The golden window feels narrow or the timing is inconsistent; a bit frustrating not to see the needle while I hold. Also smoke over a round icon in the middle station (top right, a scoop/pin icon) - something there burns too? Try 1.6s.

1.6s: smoke again, dots still 6. Confused - maybe the smoke is leftover from the last burn, or the cart is still recovering. No marker visible on the ring this time. Let me wait a couple seconds and look before trying again.

Cart is calm now. But the middle station keeps puffing black smoke from the 2nd little machine on the top-right (near the round scoop icon). Some cups there look brown. Curious - I'll tap that smoking spot.

Tapping that machine selected it: a white info card opened at the top: 24 > 28, a red -3, a bar 36/900, a clock ~53, and three icons (caramel cup selected, a locked chocolate cup, a circular arrows). The bottom button now upgrades THIS machine: 400 for +24->+28. Red minus buttons appeared on a few machines (remove?). The -3 worries me - maybe it's losing money? I'll buy the upgrade for this caramel machine.

Bought: 28 > 34 now. But the progress bar target went 900 -> 1300 and the clock ~53 -> ~81. So upgrading made the locked chocolate cup further away?? Not sure what 36/1300 counts. Next upgrade 1000 (greyed, can't afford). Going back to the cart: hold 1.7s.

1.7s golden (marker in lower yellow) and - BOOM - popcorn explosion all over the cart, the 9 dots reset to empty. Did I complete the meter? Looked like it went 6 -> full. Fun burst! Coins only +45 though. Keep holding 1.7s.

Same 1.7s hold, this time smoke = burnt, no dot. So identical holds give golden or burnt. Either the needle speeds up after a full meter, or my finger timing is laggy. Frustrating because I can't see the needle move while I hold. Try 1.4s to see if the window moved earlier.

Even 1.4s burnt! Theory: the cart keeps heat between pops, so holding again soon after burns faster. The little pressure gauge bottom-right of the ring might show heat. I'll let it cool 5s, then hold 1.2s.
1.2s after cooling: burnt again. I'm lost now - before the explosion 1.8s was golden, after it everything burns. Maybe the explosion was a level-up that made it cook faster. Trying a short 0.7s hold.
0.7s: smoke again, no dot. Maybe the smoke isn't from my holds at all. Let me hands-off for 6s and see if the cart smokes by itself.
Idle = no smoke, coins tick up passively (~50 in 7s). So my holds are what burned. Trying a plain quick tap to compare.

Even a quick tap gives a puff of smoke now. Something changed. The info card for the caramel machine has been open the whole time - maybe that matters. Let me tap the caramel machine again to close the card.
Card didn't close. I'll try the round icon at the top-left of the cart panel (two red bars) - maybe it selects the cart / opens its settings.

That icon selected the CART: the right column became a stat card (18>23, 700>750, 300>300) and a preview of the next cart look. Bottom button back to cart upgrade 1050 (+18->+23). I have 1223, buying it.

Cart upgraded, gold burst, cart wider. Stats 23>29, 750>800, and the circular-arrow stat 300>260 - maybe that's cook time, so next level cooks faster. Next upgrade 2500. Down to 208 coins. Now with cart selected, try a 1.5s hold again to see if burning was tied to the caramel card being open.

GOLDEN again! Marker at the start of the yellow (bottom-left), 2 dots lit, popcorn shower. So the burn streak happened while the caramel machine card was open - maybe holds then went somewhere else, or it was just timing. Relief. Holding 1.6s again.

1.6s burnt (marker in the red, top-left). 0.1s difference = from start of yellow to past the end of it? Feels random, like the needle is super fast at the end, or my touch timing jitters. I want to SEE the needle move while I hold. Going back to 1.45s.

Smoke again. New idea: the counter has NO customers and the top panel now has a red outline, the jar is full. Maybe the smoke isn't 'burnt' but 'wasted, nowhere to put it' - the red outline marks the bottleneck. Tap the top panel's icon to see if I can upgrade the counter/customers.

Counter selected: 17.1>27.3 (customers per minute?), clock 3.5>2.2 (seconds between customers?), 1100 coins - I have 351, can't afford. So customers are my bottleneck and my cart outruns them. Makes sense with the red outline. Saving up. Meanwhile one more cart hold at 1.4s.

1.4s: smoke again. I clearly haven't cracked the timing - golden happened at 1.5, 1.7, 1.8 and burnt at 0.7, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.7, 1.9. I suspect the needle position depends on something I can't see (heat left over?). Last try: a 1.0s hold.

1.0s: smoke too. I give up guessing the hold for now; the shop earns on its own anyway (402 coins, saving for the 1100 counter upgrade). Overall: cute, busy, upgrades feel good, but the main cooking skill feels inconsistent and I can't read why.
